title: Website and Store Down
description: Your website and online store are offline because your hosting account was suspended. The assistant has already identified the cause and a one-tap fix. Tap to see why and resolve it.

confidence.rationale: Suspension state is a direct read from the Hosting Control Panel, matched to the failed renewal in Billing.

title: Renewal Payment Failed
description: Your annual hosting renewal did not go through because the card on file expired. This is the root cause of the suspension. Updating your payment restores everything.

confidence.rationale: Declined-payment reason code is authoritative from Billing; the card expiry date confirms it.

title: Reactivation Window
description: A reactivation fee applies if the account is not restored within the grace period. You have 4 days remaining. Resolving now avoids the fee, and a loyalty credit is available for your tenure.

confidence.rationale: Grace-window countdown and fee schedule are deterministic from Billing; loyalty eligibility from the offer engine.
